text:
Maya R: Heads-up
We have signups from APAC and LATAM for next week's benchmark webinar. Need reg page timezone UX fix + replay routing rules before promo goes out.
Liam K: What specifically is broken? I tested the page and it shows attendee timezone but email shows PT.
Priya N: Looks like confirmation email uses static {{event_time_pt}} variable. Should use iso time conversion on backend.
Evan B: Quick fix: set confirmation template to use event_time_local variable from reg payload. Also include timezone suffix (e.g., 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 AM SGT).
Maya R: Also: replay opt-in checkbox must be explicit GDPR consent for EU visitors. Add separate consent for marketing follow-up.
Sara T: I'll add checkbox lines: "I consent to receive the replay (required for replay delivery)" and "I agree to receive marketing emails (optional)". We need to map selections to HubSpot lists.
Priya N: Form snippet to update:
<form id="reg">
  <input name="email" required />
  <input name="timezone" type="hidden" value="{{visitor_tz}}" />
  <label><input type="checkbox" name="replay_opt_in" /> I consent to receive the replay</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" name="marketing_opt_in" /> I agree to receive marketing emails</label>
</form>
Use server-side mapping: replay_opt_in -> list: webinar-replay, marketing_opt_in -> list: webinar-marketing
Liam K: For email triggers: send replay only to those with replay_opt_in. Non-opt-ins get a short summary email linking to public highlights after 7 days.
Maya R: Zoom setup: please record separate participant audio tracks (for podcast edits) and enable cloud recording + transcript. Also enable "Allow co-host to start recording".
Evan B: Zoom settings:
- cloud_recording: true
- record_separate_audio_files: true
- auto_transcription: true
- allow_cohost_start: true
- save_chat: true
rev-bot: Caption job queued: S3 path s3://rw-marketing/webinars/2062004321/captions/v1-auto.srt
Sara T: Lead routing rules:
- replay_opt_in=true -> nurture-replay queue (AE notify)
- marketing_opt_in=true && company_size>50 -> sales-marketing-touch
- replay_opt_in=false && marketing_opt_in=false -> low-touch drip (no AE)
Maya R: Also tag leads with utm_source + timezone for regional SDR assignment. Use visitor_tz hidden field.
Priya N: Post-event SLA: 0-12h attach auto SRT + raw mp4 to drive, 24-48h edited clip package, 72h full replay + transcript QA.
Liam K: I'll add a QuickSight dashboard to monitor signups by tz and consent flags.
Maya R: Great. Can we get confirmation that reg page is updated and tests pass by EOD? If yes, we'll push the promo.
Sara T: Updated reg page and QAed timezone display (tested US, UK, SGT). Pushed to staging. Link: https://staging.redwood.ai/events/inference-bench-2026
Evan B: Zoom meeting settings saved, recording scheduled. rev-bot will run captions on stop.
Maya R: Thanks team
Moving to done once captions + drive assets land. :white_check_mark:
